string-array.name: faq_questions
string-array.item: How do I allow the app to use camera?
How do I scan a Sudoku puzzle from a photo?
How do I enter the numbers manually?
Are there any in-app purchases or ads?

string-array.name: faq_answers
string-array.item: Go to the main screen and click on "Camera" in the bottom navigation bar.
Go to the main screen and click on "Manual" in the bottom navigation bar.
Very obviously, it does work offline.
Not yet, but we are planning to show ads in the future.
